findings: Caller refinement: SummarySheet onConfirm checks !uiState.isApplyingChanges before invoking applyChanges. This narrows the prior repeated-apply finding to missing handler admission and possible state-propagation timing; ordinary visible callback has a guard.
Summary reset/revert callbacks and ModalBottomSheet dismiss remain unguarded during applying. Main screen navigation and swipe callbacks also receive no applying gate in these ranges.
Volume up/down ACTION_DOWN events are always consumed by the screen; when muted they attempt unmute, otherwise no volume action is forwarded. Device keyboard/focus behavior is untested.

Video player is shared per screen composition, paused on lifecycle pause and released on disposal. Resume always plays a video, even if the user paused it before backgrounding; user pause intent is not tracked.
Video source changes stop and clear the previous item before preparing the new URI. Player error handling is not present in the read lifecycle block; no playback runtime qualification.
BackHandler uses onNavigateUpAndReset for completed empty sessions while toolbar back always calls ViewModel.onNavigateUp. These navigation paths have different reset behavior.
Already-organized Close directly finishes the Activity. This is whole-app closure rather than only leaving the session; no action was executed.
